home.title: Home
home.heroDesc: An all-in-one AI integration solution for enterprises, empowering digital transformation
home.heroDescExtended: Ready-to-use AI-driven SaaS framework with multi-tenancy, RAG, agents, and plugin extensions.
home.aboutIntro: NovusAI SaaS is a ready-to-use AI-driven SaaS framework with three portals: Platform Admin, Tenant Admin, and User Portal. Platform admins manage tenants, plans, AI providers and model quotas; tenant admins configure org structure, agents, knowledge bases and user permissions; end users leverage AI chat and Q&A for productive workflows.
home.techBackend: Python 3.10+ / FastAPI / SQLAlchemy 2 / PostgreSQL / Redis / Celery
home.techFrontend: Vue 3 / TypeScript / Vite / Ant Design Vue / Pinia / Socket.IO
home.capabilitiesIntro: Enterprise-grade features out of the box
home.tenantDesc: Sign in or register to access your workspace
home.featureAIDesc: Smart conversations, knowledge base Q&A, automated workflows
home.featureMultiTenantDesc: Tenant isolation, independent configuration, flexible scaling
home.featureSecurityDesc: RBAC permissions, audit logs, data encryption
home.featureRAGDesc: Document parsing, vector retrieval, smart Q&A, multi-format support with chunk strategies
home.featurePluginDesc: UMD dynamic loading, menu registration, frontend and backend extensions
home.featureDomainDesc: Tenant-specific domains, SSL certificates, multi-tenant domain isolation
